components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            after stripping; the stored and returned value is those 10 digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. The stored and returned value is lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials

## Summary

Telephone numbers are now stored and returned in **E.164 form**, replacing the old "exactly 10 digits" behavior.

**Core logic — `TelephoneNormalizer.java`**
- `canonicalize(String)` (never rejects, used for comparison and stored form): strips all non-digit characters (spaces, dashes, brackets, etc.). If the input starts with `+`, the country code is kept as-is; otherwise `+61` is assumed and a single leading `0` is dropped from the national digits. Returns `"+" + digits`.
- `normalize(String)` (used on create): calls `canonicalize`, then requires **8–15 digits after the `+`**, throwing `InvalidOwnerFieldsException` (→ 400) otherwise.
- Duplicate detection in `OwnerRestControllerV1` already compared `normalize(new)` against `canonicalize(existing)` — since both now yield the same E.164 string, duplicates are detected on E.164 values with no controller change needed.

**Supporting changes**
- `Owner.java`: replaced the `@Digits(integer=10)` / `@Pattern("^[0-9]{10}$")` entity constraints with `@Pattern("^\\+[0-9]{8,15}$")` so the persisted E.164 value validates (dropped the now-unused `@Digits` import). This was essential — the old pattern would have rejected `+61412345678` on flush.
- `openapi.yml`: updated the `telephone` field description and example to document the E.164 behavior.

**Verification against the tests**
- `0412 345 678` → `+61412345678` ✓
- `+64 21 123 456` → `+6421123456` (explicit country code kept) ✓
- `12` → `+6112` (4 digits < 8) → 400 ✓
- `uniqueTelephone()` (`04XXXXXXXX`) → `+614XXXXXXXX` (11 digits), valid across the rule chain ✓
